translation.title: Felbinac Adhesive patch
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner from the medicated side and apply one patch twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; people who have experienced asthma, urticaria or acute rhinitis with aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people with bronchial asthma; children. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: damaged skin; mucous membranes; eczema; areas of rash. Itching, erythema (red patches), redness, dermatitis (rash, eczema) and contact dermatitis may occur occasionally, and irritation or blisters rarely. If these symptoms are severe, stop using it. Store at room temperature, protected from light.
